title: Spoken text is interpolated into TwiML without XML escaping
method: built the TwiML for a realistic name and medication and parsed it
observed_at_discovery: xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError: not well-formed (invalid token): line 4, column 60. Twilio rejects a malformed document, CuraVoice swallows the rejection into CallResult.error, and _run_scheduled prints 'check-in sent' (FS-e563f4667178). The phone stops ringing and the screen keeps saying it rang.
